name: Arduino UNO R3
record_note: The UNO R3 uses a 16 MHz ceramic resonator for the ATmega328P and an ATmega16U2 USB-to-serial bridge. UART0 remains shared with the D0/D1 headers. Board pin constraints, build/flash profiles, and physical-revision confirmation remain open.

onboard_devices.name: ATmega16U2
onboard_devices.function: USB-to-serial bridge for the ATmega328P target
onboard_devices.notes: The bridge shares the target UART0 pins brought out as D0/RX and D1/TX.
